'''Qingbo Light Armor''' is a {{gear|5|Armor}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC Factory. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|Very economic equipment, created according to ancient scrolls and books found in Qingbo Stockade.
A suit of light armor assembled by weaving special bamboo strips with extremely resilient leather. Qingbo Stockade was surrounded by many wild creatures when it was first founded. Defensive gear made using beast hides was quite common back then.}}
